This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

The word "AI" assumes the answers under debate, and he is suspicious nobody called his proposals wrong.
raw: {"choice":"other","why":"The dissent objects to terminology and to the deliberation process itself: \"The word \"AI\" assumes the answers under debate\" and suspicion that \"nobody called his proposals wrong.\" It says nothing about opt-in, levies, or paying for training data, and nothing about whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room."}
